dataset: industrial weld radiographs; inventory and taxonomy pending
unit: whole radiograph image; independence enforced by source group
attention_location: after layer4, before global average pooling
attention_definition: channel mean/max -> concat -> 7x7 conv -> sigmoid; multiply spatially; not full CBAM
initialization: ImageNet supervised weights; common backbone tensors paired; exact version/hash pending
budget_control: same optimizer updates and batch size; actual wall time separately reported
cluster_k_rule: choose once on calibration-only frozen ImageNet features, silhouette over feasible k=2..10, ties -> smaller k; freeze across models
pca: none in primary experiment; optional calibration-fit only sensitivity analysis
clustering_fit_pool: fixed unlabeled calibration split, excluded from representation training and final test
primary_metric: ARI on predeclared eligible single-defect test images
primary_contrast: equal-weight mean of paired ARI attention-minus-baseline differences at training ratios 0.1, 0.5, 1.0; report all ratios
training_size_role: controlled factor; not a parameter recommendation
checkpoint_rule: fixed final optimizer step; no test-based selection

geometry_spec.distance: euclidean; class/class-pair balanced; exclude same source groups
geometry_spec.pair_sampling: exact blocked accumulation; any approximation must be specified before test access

pilot_protocol: separate local pilot protocol must freeze after audit; not authorized by final-protocol CLI
